title: Confirming borrowed molds in the quarterly register
titleZh: 季度登記表：確認借入的模具
passage:
To: Fabrication leads
Subject: Confirming borrowed molds in the quarterly register

Please reconcile the mold register by Friday. A mold can appear in our register without belonging to us. The quarterly wear figures are meant to show how quickly our own molds wear out, so leave items marked “borrowed” out of those figures, even if we used them all quarter. The register itself must still list them.

For molds we do own, use the wear reading from the last production run wherever possible. If a mold was resurfaced later, that renewal does not replace the old reading. Record the new surface as the starting condition for the next quarter. There is one exception: if the mold ran again after resurfacing, use that run’s reading for this quarter instead.

Mold 12 belongs to us. It ran on Tuesday and its surface was renewed on Wednesday. The workshop reserved it for a Thursday trial but used a borrowed spare when the renewal took longer than expected. The trial record shows a reading for that spare; the renewal sheet also shows a reading for Mold 12 taken before it returned to the shop floor. I’ve attached both records for reference.
passageZh:
收件人：製造組領班
主旨：季度登記表：確認借入的模具

請在星期五前完成模具登記表的核對。模具即使列在我們的登記表上，也不一定屬於我們。季度磨耗數據是要了解自有模具磨損的速度；因此，標記為「借入」的模具不列入磨耗數據，即使整季都用過也一樣。登記表本身仍須列出這些模具。

自有模具應盡量採用最後一次生產作業的磨耗讀數。如果模具後來重整了表面，不能以重整後的狀態取代舊讀數。請把重整好的表面記為下一季的初始狀態。只有一種例外：若模具在重整表面後又投入生產，本季應改採那次作業的讀數。

12 號模具是我們的。它星期二投入生產，星期三重整了表面。工坊原本預留它做星期四的試作，但因表面重整比預期久，實際上用了借來的備用模具。試作紀錄上有備用模具的讀數；表面重整表上也有一筆讀數，是 12 號模具回到現場之前量得的。兩份紀錄都附上供你們參考。
